title: Existence of the normalized section pullback comparison
statement:
theorem section_pull_transport_section_normalized {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (cX : ScalarSectionData a X) (cY : ScalarSectionData a Y)
    (hcX : ScalarSectionNormalized a X cX) (hcY : ScalarSectionNormalized a Y cY)
    (lam : D a Y ⋙ L Λ' f ≅ L Λ f ⋙ D a X) (hlam : PullNormalized a f lam) :
    ∃ barLam : cY.model.T ⋙ derivedPullback Λ' f ≅ derivedPullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.T,
      SectionPullNormalized a f cX cY barLam

proof.text: Apply section_pull_transport_section_normalized_kflat to obtain the normalized comparison on flat-term K-flat representatives, then apply section_pull_transport_extend_kflat to extend its counit equation to every complex.
